scope: isolated PostgreSQL schema; real authenticated HTTP; local SMTP capture; no private storage

checks.name: isolated schema migrations and empty account boundary
isolated HTTP server and local-only mail transport
candidate signup, captured confirmation and blocked unverified login
employer confirmation stays separate from company approval
authenticated sessions persist and reject cross-account identity
real HTTP salary ownership, duplicate submission and anonymous legacy preservation
logout invalidates previously valid candidate and employer cookies
no synthetic accounts were written to the normal schema

limitations: Not a hosted Vercel acceptance run
SMTP capture does not establish external inbox delivery
Development HttpOnly/SameSite/path cookie checks do not prove Production Secure-cookie delivery.
Public canonical email-link/browser behaviour and actual cron invocation were not tested.
